title: Agencies collect from their customers: payment links on invoices through the agency's own Razorpay or Stripe
goal: Let an agency send its customer a link to pay an invoice online and record the payment automatically.
why: payments.gateway is a stub: manual recording only, plus an unused payment_link column and a UPI id setting (audit 02).
steps: Tenant 0047: payment_gateway_accounts (id, gateway, mode test|live, key_id, secret_enc, webhook_secret_enc, is_active), invoices ADD payment_link_id, payment_link_url, payment_link_status. Secrets via utils/crypto-box.ts (R108).
Settings > Integrations: connect Razorpay or Stripe (keys pasted by the agency; a "Test connection" call with mocked fetch in tests); never show secrets after save.

POST /invoices/:id/payment-link creates a Razorpay Payment Link or Stripe Payment Link / Checkout Session for the balance due in the invoice currency, stores id/url, returns it; the invoice detail page shows "Create payment link" and, for sending, opens SendMessageDialog with the link pre-filled (Communication Hub rule).

routes/payment-webhooks.ts at /api/v1/webhooks/payments/:tenantKey/:gateway (public; tenantKey = a per-tenant random key stored in master tenant_channel_addresses kind payment_webhook): verify with the tenant's webhook secret, idempotent on gateway event id (reuse provider_events-like table: add payment_events in 0047), record the payment through the same domain function as manual payments (emits payment.recorded), update invoice status.
tests: backend/test/payment-links.test.ts: link created with mocked gateway fetch for INR and GBP; signed webhook records one payment and marks the invoice paid; replay ignored; wrong tenantKey -> 404; bad signature -> 400; payment.recorded event emitted once.
acceptance: Payments from links appear exactly once (tests).
Links are sent only through the Communication Hub.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/invoices.spec.ts e2e/payments.spec.ts e2e/webhooks-integrations.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: An agency's real test-mode Razorpay and Stripe accounts end to end.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, FilterBar + infinite scroll, RelationCombobox, PhoneInput, useConfirm, graceful degradation). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.

Bulk seeding in tests or e2e (many leads, messages or payments) triggers automation recipes; set settings.automations_paused = true for that tenant first (PUT /api/v1/automations/pause or the setting row), then restore it.
